Name: XP Display
Author: Shockah
Description:
[size=6]TL;DR:[/size]
[size=4]Displays the progress to reach the next level of each skill.[/size]

[size=6]Mod compatibility[/size]
The mod has special compatibility code for the following mods:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] (and in turn any mods adding custom skills with it, like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14142]Socializing[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22199]Archaeology[/url]﻿)
[*][url=https://github.com/Pet-Slime/StardewValley/releases/tag/v1.1.0]Luck Skill Spacecore[/url] - Compatible with MoonSlimes SpaceCore remake
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk Of Life - Rebirth[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/daleao/modular-overhaul][s]MARGO[/s][/url]﻿ - hasn't been update for SDV 1.6 yet
[/list]

[size=6]Configuration[/size]
The mod has [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] support. You can also edit the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file manually.

[size=6]Other info[/size]
You can find the source code [url=https://github.com/Shockah/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/master/XPDisplay]here[/url].
